plugins.name: loomwright
plugins.description: Loomwright is a plan-first, multi-agent development system for Claude Code. Launch Pad turns a goal into a reviewed brief; Supervisor executes it autonomously across parallel git worktrees with self-heal; dedicated agents cover code review, red-teaming, QA, and standalone PR review-and-heal. 14 agent roles, 24 slash commands, 42 skills, 43 quality gate hooks. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.

plugins.name: stackpack
plugins.description: Stackpack v1.0.0 — generic tech-stack reference skills (Next.js, NestJS, API-gateway patterns, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker) spun out of Loomwright; 18 skills, no agents/commands/hooks. Install alongside loomwright@atelier.

plugins.name: mysql-mcp
plugins.description: Mysql-mcp v1.0.1 — the read-only MySQL MCP server (vikashruhil-mysql-mcp via uvx) spun out of Loomwright, pinned to `==1.0.1`. Resolves DB_HOST/DB_USER/DB_PASS/DB_NAME(/DB_PORT) from the environment. No agents/commands/skills/hooks.
